artifact.title: Emergent Interaction & Dynamic Equilibrium
key_findings: System-level interactions deserve validation independent of component validation.
Governance requires consolidation as it grows.
Confidence should be periodically recalibrated against new independent evidence.

working_hypothesis.name: Dynamic Equilibrium
working_hypothesis.statement: Long-lived engineering systems appear to evolve paired balancing mechanisms that prevent any single stabilizing mechanism from becoming a source of engineering debt.
